hooks.command: i=$(cat); f=$(printf '%s' "$i" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); t=$(printf '%s' "$i" | jq -r '.transcript_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.md|*.mdx) grep -qE '"(file_path|command)":"[^"]*user-facing-docs/SKILL\.md' "$t" 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Read ~/.cache/ricochet-rs/agent-instructions/skills/user-facing-docs/SKILL.md before editing documentation, and never use middle voice."}}';; esac; exit 0
